source: Curated. Carried forward from two sibling research projects, each of which cites primary sources per row.

source_projects.name: Microreactor Opportunity Map
source_projects.contributes: Vendor specs (coolant, fuel, refuel interval, transport, footprint), the opportunity/commitment set, and the sector demand ladder.
source_projects.method: Web search only; every row carries at least one source URL.

source_projects.name: Deployment Core
source_projects.contributes: The six evidence bands, the Microreactor-lane company roster with its roster basis, and the 2026 criticality record.
source_projects.method: Primary regulator and agency sources outrank company reporting; a megawatt sits in exactly one band.

evidence_bands.label: Nuclear construction
evidence_bands.rule: NRC construction permit issued and physical nuclear work documented.

evidence_bands.label: DOE-authorized build
evidence_bands.rule: Built under a DOE authorization pathway with physical work documented. Not an NRC license to operate.

evidence_bands.label: Under review
evidence_bands.rule: Construction-permit or combined-license application docketed and in active regulator review.

evidence_bands.label: Contracted
evidence_bands.rule: An executed, funded agreement for a named project — offtake, order, delivery, or development funding — not yet in regulator review.

evidence_bands.label: Announced, non-binding
evidence_bands.rule: MOU, LOI, master agreement, or announced target. No executed project documents.

vendors.name: Radiant Nuclear
vendors.fuel: HALEU TRISO (Standard Nuclear, Oak Ridge TN)
vendors.band_basis: First new reactor design fuelled in DOE's DOME test bed at INL; signed delivery agreement with the Defense Innovation Unit and the Department of the Air Force.
vendors.funding_note: $300M Series D on top of a $165M Series C; total raised >$500M. Reactor factory foundation in Oak Ridge, TN in 2026.

vendors.name: Terrestrial Energy
vendors.mwe_label: TETRA-1 pilot output not disclosed (commercial IMSR is 195 MWe/core)

vendors.name: Oklo
vendors.mwe_label: up to 75 MWe — above the ≤20 MWe microreactor band
vendors.band_basis: Aurora-INL under construction under the DOE Reactor Pilot Program with a combined-license application submitted to the NRC. Groves reached first criticality on private land 2026-08-06.
vendors.adjacent_note: Listed as an ADJACENCY, not a microreactor vendor. The Aurora design scaled from 15 MWe through 50 MWe to a current 75 MWe maximum, so it sits above the microreactor band — but Oklo holds the Eielson award, which is the highest-value remote-base opportunity in this pipeline.

sources.label: Oklo — breaks ground on first Aurora powerhouse
Oklo — Groves reactor achieves first criticality

gaps: Primary Eielson award document not re-verified — carried forward from the Microreactor Opportunity Map, not freshly sourced
